params.body:
Every mail from gentells.com went out with a broken logo. The mail header (`resources/views/vendor/mail/html/header.blade.php`) loads `brand/gentells-wordmark@2x.png`, and only `gentells-wordmark.svg` was in the repo; `https://gentells.com/brand/gentells-wordmark@2x.png` answers 404.

- **The PNG:** rendered from the SVG at twice its display width (320 × 41 px, transparent), as the header's comment describes.
- **`MailAssetsTest`:** every `asset('…')` a mail view names must exist in `public/`. Without the PNG it fails and names the file.

326 tests pass.
params.title: The mail wordmark exists: every gentells.com mail showed a broken logo
